read_rows.label: the record -- the scope split, statement-grade
read_rows.text: **Scope split (W-INFORMATION run, 2026-07-28 — statement-grade, nothing retracted).** E-Difficulty is **not** one face of the difficulty-kinds typology; it separates into **(a)** a cross-cutting **proof-architecture theorem** — decidability of a universal property ⟺ a domain Ostrowski exists — holding across all difficulty-kinds (RH is Kind A and is *also* proved by catalogue-exhaustion; four-color is Kind B and likewise), and **(b)** the **ladder** THEOREM > SEARCH > FORCED-OR-UNDERDETERMINED > NONE, which **is** the Kind-B fine structure. The precondition sharpens to **"has a finite mechanism catalogue"** (arithmetic ∪ finite-combinatorial substrate); **Shannon is the worked negative** — axiomatically forced, no mechanism catalogue, outside the precondition. The escape-kind grades *how* completeness is reached; the absence-dual names *which class* fails to clear; both refine **within** (b). The compiled skeletons keep their pins either way — this is a framing split, not a retraction.

read_rows.text: **Kernel verification.** The structural form of Proposition 1 is verified in `SIDE-interfaces` (`Interfaces/ConservationProfile.lean::interface_split`): for any `ConservationProfile P` with `¬ IsAllStructural P`, the kernel proves `structuralRank P < dim P`. The full source-fidelity form with explicit `f : A → B` and parameter family `θ : params → A → ℝ` is reserved for the future `SIDE-interface-split` kernel (LV-L-1b). *(Re-grade 2026-07-15 — both facts: accurate at this paper's pin, where only the structural form `interface_split` stood; the source-fidelity form has since **closed** as `Interfaces/InterfaceSplit.lean::interface_split_faithful` at `SIDE-interfaces` HEAD `cbdcd5f`. No separate `SIDE-interface-split` repo was needed — LV-L-1b landed inside `SIDE-interfaces`.)*
